subject: FintechCorp — security discovery follow-up & IR/BCP requests
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FintechCorp — security discovery follow-up & IR/BCP requests

Hi Alice — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- You're evaluating Redwood for customer-facing fraud-detection workflows (low-latency inference).
- Primary compliance items you flagged: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, vendor security questionnaire, and incident/breach-notification timelines.

Can you confirm the following please: 
1) Current SOC 2 status (Type I/II and date of last assessment) and whether the SOC 2 report can be shared under NDA.
2) Any HIPAA scope for the integration (PHI in inputs/outputs) or GDPR data processing questions we should be aware of.
3) Preferred procurement contact and timeline for a standard MSSA/DSA.

Separately, could you start the vendor security questionnaire? I’ve attached our security incident response template for reference (redwood-security-incident-response-template.docx) — it lists the timelines we typically provide to customers.

I’ll also loop Jordan (IR lead) and Rishi (security/compliance) to provide our standard breach notification timelines and BCP/DR evidence. Goal: pull together the SOC2 report + completed questionnaire + minimum BCP artifacts this week so procurement can move to legal.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-security-incident-response-template.docx

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechcorp.com>

Cc: Bob Li <bob.li@fintechcorp.com>, procurements@fintechcorp.com
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCorp — security discovery follow-up & IR/BCP requests

Hi Marissa — great to meet you and the team today. Answers below: 

1) SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II in Dec 2025. We can share a redacted report under NDA; I’ve attached the SOC2 report and the SOC attestation (FintechCorp-SOC2-Report-2025.pdf).
2) HIPAA/GDPR: We are HIPAA-aware but the current scope for this integration will not include PHI. GDPR: we process EU data for some customers; we'll confirm data residency needs but nothing blocking at this stage.
3) Procurement: please include procurements@fintechcorp.com and Bob Li on any contract threads. Target timeline: intent to sign by mid-April pending security questionnaire and standard DPA language.

We’re happy to accept your incident response timelines — please send the exact SLAs and examples of BCP evidence (DR tests, runbooks).

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Head of Security Operations, FintechCorp
alice.chen@fintechcorp.com
Attachment: FintechCorp-SOC2-Report-2025.pdf

Thanks for the quick turn, Alice — much appreciated. 

Next steps from our side: 
- I’m attaching the vendor security questionnaire (Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire_Redwood.xlsx). Can you confirm the right owner at FintechCorp to complete/verify?
- Jordan/Rishi: can you provide our standard incident response timelines and a minimal set of BCP/DR artifacts we can share with FintechCorp this week (DR test report, RTO/RPO, runbook excerpt, contact tree)?

We want to be explicit on breach notification timing so procurement has clear expectations (FintechCorp asked about 72-hour and “as soon as reasonably practicable” windows).

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute follow-up with security/ops to walk through the questionnaire and the IR/DR items. Suggested times: Wed 3/31 10am-11am PT or Thu 4/1 1pm-3pm PT.

Cheers,
Marissa

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCorp — security discovery follow-up & IR/BCP requests

Hi all — Jordan here (Head of IR at Redwood). Quick note on what we can provide immediately: 

- Incident response timeline: initial acknowledgement within 1 hour of detection/notification; 24-hour status updates; target preliminary impact assessment within 72 hours; full incident report within 7 business days for standard incidents (serious incidents may have a longer investigation period). See attached IR-Timeline.pdf for the standard template.

- Breach notification: we will notify customers as required by applicable law (GDPR: within 72 hours where applicable; HIPAA: per the HIPAA rule and HHS guidance). We will collaborate with FintechCorp privacy/security teams on messaging and timelines.

- BCP/DR evidence: we can provide a redacted DR runbook, the latest full DR test report (most recent: 2025-11-12), RTO/RPO SLA summary, and screenshots from recent failover tests. Attaching DR-Test-Report-2025-11-12.pdf and a one-page IR timeline.

We normally accept an NDA before sharing full SOC artifacts; since FintechCorp already has a SOC report attached, we can align on a short NDA if you need additional exhibits.

Jordan Blake
Head of Incident Response, Redwood Inference
Attachment: IR-Timeline.pdf; DR-Test-Report-2025-11-12.pdf
